integrity: The formula is separated from prior qualitative omega-categoricity and automorphism-group results. The proof uses the published semidirect automorphism decomposition plus an explicit Cantor-clopen support classification; finite computations are sanity checks only.
scientific_limitations: The exact profile is proved for filtered Boolean powers by the countable atomless Boolean algebra after reducing to distinct filtering-idempotent automorphism orbits. Other Stone spaces can carry extra topological data. Older Boolean-power literature was searched but not exhaustively inspected line by line, so residual folklore risk remains.
title: Exact oligomorphic profiles of filtered Boolean powers
